title: feat: Edit playlists right in the reader, with the new step editor
summary: The playlist editor is rebuilt. Before, making a playlist meant filling in a form in the Discover panel while the Bible reader beside it stayed the same. Now the reader itself is the editor: the steps are listed in a floating panel, scripture steps are picked by tapping verses in the reader, other steps (note, question, video, compare) get their own card over the reader, and a **Review & publish** window holds the name, description and cover. On a phone the editor takes over the Bible tab. Saved playlists keep the same format, so playing them works as before.

setup.title: Open the preview build on a computer
setup.body: Use the **Open the preview build** button above, in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a laptop or desktop, with the browser window at full width. If the page shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be deploying: wait a few minutes and reload.

setup.title: Make sure you have the new version
setup.body: The app saves a copy of itself in your browser, so it can show an older version. Do a hard refresh once: **Ctrl+Shift+R** on Windows, or **Cmd+Shift+R** on Mac.

setup.title: Sign in
setup.body: Sign in with your email. Seed Bible emails you a code, so use an address whose inbox you can check. Only signed-in readers can create playlists.

setup.title: Know how to start a new playlist
setup.body: Open **Discover** from the app's menu. At the top of the Discover panel, choose **+ Create**, then **Playlist**. Several tests start this way.

sections.title: Opening the editor and adding steps

tests.title: Creating a playlist opens the editor over the reader
steps: In the reader, open **John 1**.
Open **Discover**, choose **+ Create**, then **Playlist**.
expected: A floating panel appears on the right with the heading **Untitled playlist**, a pencil button beside it, and the status **Draft** under it.
The panel says `0 steps · ~0 min` and **No steps yet. Add one to get started.**
There's an **+ Add new step** button at the bottom of the panel.
At the bottom of the reader there's an **Edit** / **Preview** switch and a **Review & publish** button. The reader's usual toolbar under the text is gone.

tests.title: Rename the playlist
tests.before: Keep the editor from the last test open.
steps: Click the pencil button next to **Untitled playlist**.
Type `Test playlist` and press **Enter**.
expected: The heading now reads **Test playlist**.
The status under it changes to **Draft - Unsaved changes**.

tests.title: Add a scripture step by tapping verses
steps: Click **+ Add new step**.
Look at the **Add a step** menu that opens.
Choose **Scripture**.
In the reader (still **John 1**), click verse 1, then click verse 5.
In the bar at the bottom, read the text, then click **Apply**.
expected: The menu lists **Scripture**, **Note**, **Video**, **Question** and **Compare**, each with a short description, and says **Inserted as the first step**.
After choosing Scripture, a bar at the bottom says **Tap verses for step 1** with **Cancel** and **Apply** buttons.
After picking verses, the bar shows the passage you picked (verses 1 to 5 of John 1).
After **Apply**, the step list shows one step labelled with John 1:1–5 and `Scripture · 1 min`.
In the reader, verses 1–5 are highlighted and the rest of the chapter is dimmed, with a `1/1` marker in the margin next to verse 1.

tests.title: Cancel leaves a scripture step's passage as it was
tests.before: The John 1:1–5 step from the last test is open.
steps: Click verse 10 in the reader.
Click **Cancel** in the bar at the bottom.
expected: The pick bar appears when you click a verse (**Tap verses for step 1**).
After **Cancel**, the bar goes away and the step is still John 1:1–5, both in the step list and in the highlighted verses.

tests.title: Write a note under a scripture passage
steps: Under the highlighted passage, click **+ Add a note to this item**.
Type `Notice the word light.`
expected: A text box appears under the passage, labelled **Your note · shown with John 1:1–5** (or similar).
What you type stays there, and the status still says **Draft - Unsaved changes**.

tests.title: Add a note step
steps: Click **+ Add new step** and choose **Note**.
Type `Before we begin` in **Title** and `Read slowly.` in the note box.
expected: The menu said **Inserted after step 1** before you chose.
A card appears over the reader with the heading **Step 2 · Note**, a **Title** field and a **Note** box with a character count.
The step list now has two steps; the second is labelled **Before we begin** with `Note · 1 min`.

tests.title: Add a question step
steps: Click **+ Add new step** and choose **Question**.
In **Question**, type `What does light reveal in your life?`
In **Hint for readers**, type `Think about this week.`
Under **Who sees responses**, click **Shared with group**, then **Private reflection**.
expected: A card with the heading **Step 3 · Question** appears.
The two choices under **Who sees responses** are **Private reflection** (Only the reader sees it) and **Shared with group** (Group members can read it), and only the one you clicked last is selected.
The step list shows the question text as the step's name, with `Question · 1 min`.

tests.title: Add a video step and check its link
steps: Click **+ Add new step** and choose **Video**.
In **Video link**, type `hello`.
Clear it and paste `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ` instead.
expected: With `hello`, the card says **That isn't a web address.**
With the YouTube link, it says **Link looks good**, and after a moment the **Title** field offers the video's own title.
There's a **Show transcript** switch (Displayed below the video).

tests.title: Add a compare step
steps: Click **+ Add new step** and choose **Compare**.
In **Passage A**, type `Genesis 1:1`. In **Passage B**, type `John 1:1`.
Under **Layout for readers**, click **Stacked**, then **Side by side**.
expected: A card with **Passage A**, **Passage B**, **What to notice** and **Layout for readers** appears.
The text of each verse appears below its box after you type the reference.
Only one layout is selected at a time.
The step list now shows 5 steps, the last one **Compare verses** with `Compare · 1 min`.

sections.title: Working with steps
sections.intro: These use the five-step playlist built in the last section.

tests.title: Reading time, Pause for group and Leader only
steps: Click the first step (John 1:1–5) in the step list.
In the toolbar at the top of the reader, find **Reading time** and click the **More time** (+) button twice.
Turn on **Pause for group** and **Leader only**.
Click another step, then click the first step again.
expected: Reading time goes from `1 min` to `3 min`, and the step list shows `Scripture · 3 min`.
The total at the top of the panel goes up by 2 minutes (`5 steps · ~7 min`).
When you come back to the first step, Reading time is still `3 min` and both switches are still on.
The **Less time** button doesn't go below 1 minute.

tests.title: Duplicate, reorder and delete a step
steps: Click step 2 (**Before we begin**) in the step list.
Click its **Duplicate step** button (two squares) in the list.
Drag the copy by its handle (the dotted grip on the left) to the bottom of the list.
With that copy open, click **Delete step** (the bin icon).
expected: Duplicate adds a second **Before we begin** right after the first, opens it, and the count becomes 6 steps.
Dragging moves it to the bottom and the other steps keep their order.
Delete removes it and the list is back to 5 steps, in the original order.

tests.title: Link a note to another step
steps: Open step 2 (**Before we begin**).
Click at the end of the note text. In the **INSERT** row, click **Link item** and choose **Step 1**.
expected: A link to step 1 (labelled with **Step 1** and the passage) is added to the note text.
This link is checked during playback in a later test.

tests.title: Preview shows steps as readers will see them
steps: Open step 1 and click **Preview** at the bottom of the reader.
Click through the other steps in the list.
Click **Edit** to go back.
expected: In Preview, the step toolbar (Reading time, switches) is hidden, and the step note under John 1:1–5 is shown as plain text, not a text box.
The note, question, video and compare steps show without editing fields.
**Edit** brings the editing fields back with nothing lost.

tests.title: An unfinished step blocks publishing
steps: Click **+ Add new step** and choose **Video**, but leave **Video link** empty.
Click **Review & publish**.
expected: The empty video step is marked as unfinished in the step list.
The **Review & publish** window shows **Title**, **Description** and **Cover image**, plus the step count.
It says **These steps need finishing before you publish:** with a link to the video step, and **Publish** can't be clicked.
Clicking that step's link closes the window and opens the video step.

tests.title: Publish the playlist
steps: Delete the empty video step (open it, then **Delete step**).
Click **Review & publish**. Type `A test playlist` in **Description**.
Click **Publish**.
expected: The window shows **Saving…** briefly, then closes.
The editor closes and the reader goes back to normal, with its usual toolbar.
**Test playlist** is listed in Discover among your playlists.

tests.title: Play the published playlist
tests.why: Questions and comparisons are stored as notes and scripture steps so older versions of the app can still read them. The PR doesn't say exactly how a question or compare step looks during playback, so note what you see.
steps: In Discover, click the play button on **Test playlist**.
Go through every step.
On step 2, click the **Step 1** link in the note.
expected: Step 1 opens John 1 at verses 1–5 and shows the note `Notice the word light.`
Step 2 shows **Before we begin** and `Read slowly.`
Step 3 shows the question text, step 4 the video, step 5 the passage(s) you compared.
Clicking the **Step 1** link jumps playback back to step 1.

tests.title: Edit a saved playlist and see Saved status
steps: Stop playing. In Discover, open the options menu (⋯, Playlist options) on **Test playlist** and choose **Edit**.
expected: The editor opens with all 5 steps and the name **Test playlist**.
The status under the name says **Saved**.

tests.title: Leaving with unsaved changes asks first
tests.before: The editor for **Test playlist** is open from the last test.
steps: Rename the playlist to `Test playlist 2`.
Click the **X** (Close playlist editor) at the top right of the step panel.
Click **Go back**.
Click the **X** again and choose **Confirm**.
Open the playlist in the editor again.
expected: The status changed to **Draft - Unsaved changes** after renaming.
Closing shows an **Unsaved changes** window with **Confirm**, **Go back** and **Save & exit**.
**Go back** leaves you in the editor with your change.
**Confirm** closes the editor without saving: reopening shows **Test playlist**, not **Test playlist 2**.

tests.title: Closing without changes doesn't ask
steps: With the editor open and nothing changed (status **Saved**), click the **X** at the top right of the step panel.
expected: The editor closes straight away with no window, and the reader goes back to normal.

setup.title: Use a phone
setup.body: Open the same preview link on a phone, or make your computer's browser window narrow (about phone width) and reload. Sign in with the same account.

tests.title: The editor takes over the Bible tab on a phone
steps: Open **Discover** and choose **Edit** from the options menu (⋯) on **Test playlist**.
expected: The Bible tab shows the editor: at the top the playlist name and a line like `5 items · 7 min · Saved`.
At the bottom there's an **Items** button with a `1/5` badge, **+ Add**, and **Review & publish**.
Nothing overlaps or runs off the edge of the screen.

tests.title: The step sheet and step settings on a phone
steps: Tap **Items**.
Tap step 3 (the question) in the sheet.
Tap **Step Settings** under the question card.
Tap **+ Add**, choose **Note**, and type `Phone note`.
expected: **Items** opens a sheet from the bottom with the step list; tapping a step closes the sheet and opens that step. The badge now says `3/5`.
**Step Settings** opens Reading time, Pause for group and Leader only for that step.
The new note step is added after step 3 and the badge says `4/6`.

tests.title: Tap verses for a scripture step on a phone
steps: Tap **+ Add** and choose **Scripture**.
Tap two verses in the reader, then tap **Apply**.
expected: A **Tap verses for step …** bar appears above the bottom buttons, then shows the verses you picked.
After **Apply**, the passage is highlighted and the rest of the chapter is dimmed.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: The reader is normal when not editing a playlist
steps: Close the playlist editor (on the phone choose **Confirm** if asked, to throw away the test changes).
On a computer, open any chapter, then select a verse and look at the toolbar under the text.
expected: The usual reader toolbar is back, nothing is dimmed, and there's no step panel or **Review & publish** button.
Selecting verses works as before (no **Tap verses for step** bar).

tests.title: Creating an annotation still works
steps: In Discover, choose **+ Create**, then **Annotation**.
expected: The annotation editor opens as before, not the playlist editor.

tests.title: Editing a playlist in dark mode
steps: Switch the app to dark mode in **Settings**.
Open **Test playlist** with **Edit** (in its ⋯ menu in Discover) and click through the steps.
expected: The step panel, cards, toolbar and bottom bar are all readable, with no white boxes or text you can't see.

notCovered: Editing a playlist with the AI chat button (the sparkle button in the step panel) only appears when an AI that can use tools is set up, so it isn't tested here.
That older versions of the app can still open playlists saved with question, compare, reading time and other new settings is covered by automated tests, not by hand.
The **Embed verse** and **Link** options in a note's **INSERT** row aren't tested separately.
